prerequisite: None (the node supplies its own two fixed-line geometries)
assertions: data.entities == 3 (fixed line + free arc + fixed line)
data.radius matches the input (+/- 0.01); tangency of the arc to both lines is a constraint property
in the geometry editor the arc behaves as 'free'; changing the radius re-solves while keeping tangency (GUI check)
len <= 0 or a read-back radius deviation > 0.01 is treated as a solver failure and throws
first_real_use: Recasting 92 corners as constrained geometry in a secondary-channel design drawing (2026-08-23)
